name: Aruna Hotels Limited
about: Aruna Hotels Limited engages in developing, owning, acquiring, renovating, operating, managing, and promoting hotels, restaurants, etc in India. The company operates the Pharos hotel located in Chennai, which includes a restaurant and bar, coffee shop, swimming pool, spa, and fitness center, banquet halls, and meeting rooms. Aruna Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Chennai, India
